newsitem.title: USA: US High Plains cattle trade up $2 at $66-feedlots.
newsitem.headline: US High Plains cattle trade up $2 at $66-feedlots.

text.p: U.S. Plains feedlot cattle were trading at $66 per cwt in both Kansas and Texas, up $2 from the bulk of trade last week, feedlot sources said.
Three packers were reported to be bidding $66 in Texas where most feedlots were accepting the offers.
"I think with the 104,000 showlist here in Texas I think they (owners) will end up taking $66 and worry about asking more money next week," one Texas source sid.
Feedlot sources estimated at least 6,000 head had traded at $66 in Texas and 2,000 head in Kansas.
Strong product values were a supportive factor.
USDA boxed beef cut-out values, as of 1130 CDT, were up $2.38 to $1.56 per cwt.
